name: Triad
author: Erin Carter
description: Three standing plane-wave trains cross at 120 degrees and sum into a honeycomb of glowing antinode cells on a vibrating bronze pan. Hash-scheduled strikes flood the lattice with shimmering amplitude that rings down at three different rates, melting the hexagons through stripe-dominant interludes before settling to a faint residual.

params.label: Cell size
params.effect: CSS-pixel scale of the hexagonal cells, from a fine cymatic mesh to a few large breathing cells.

params.label: Strike gap
params.effect: Mean seconds between hash-scheduled strikes that re-flood and reseat the lattice.

params.label: Ring time
params.effect: How long the three trains take to die away, stretching or shortening the hexagon-to-stripes melt.

params.label: Skew
params.effect: Detunes one train's wavelength so the lattice drifts toward a slow moire superlattice; zero locks a perfect honeycomb.
